name: SimSpace Senior Solution Engineer Operating System
role_mission: Operate the technical sales cycle from outcome discovery through evaluation, field engineering, tailored demonstration, technical close, and expansion while preserving measurable proof and product feedback.

tracks.label: Outcome Discovery
tracks.objective: Turn business and mission goals into explicit technical proof points, stakeholders, constraints, and buying criteria.

tracks.label: Range Blueprint
tracks.objective: Map the customer terrain across enterprise, cloud, IT, OT, and hybrid systems into a proposed simulation and evaluation architecture.

tracks.label: Evaluation & Success Criteria
tracks.objective: Define measurable pilot success criteria, evidence sources, acceptance thresholds, and executive proof before implementation begins.

tracks.label: Field Engineering & Integrations
tracks.objective: Coordinate APIs, scripts, protocols, tooling, agent integrations, and environment dependencies needed to make the evaluation real.

tracks.label: Tailored Demo / Pilot
tracks.objective: Run a believable technical evaluation, isolate blockers quickly, and preserve an evidence trail from scenario to outcome.

tracks.label: RFI / RFP Technical Narrative
tracks.objective: Translate architecture, capability mapping, security requirements, and value evidence into a decision-ready technical narrative.

tracks.label: Partner Co-Sell & Enablement
tracks.objective: Support resellers, system integrators, MSSPs, and consulting partners with a reusable technical story and proof model.

tracks.label: Technical Close, Expansion & Product Signal
tracks.objective: Resolve final technical risk, capture broader use cases, hand off cleanly, and return recurring market signal to Product.

disclosure: Candidate-built Clintware operating prototype using public SimSpace context and clearly synthetic opportunity data. It is not an official SimSpace product or tenant.
